- **The Pudding** — https://pudding.cool/

- **Bloomberg Graphics** — https://www.bloomberg.com/graphics/

- **Reuters Graphics** — https://www.reuters.com/graphics/  
  World disclosure showed no change; **More** changed to `aria-expanded=true`. Tab reached the LSEG link; Escape was sent. Mobile Menu showed no visible expansion. A loose control test reached a Reuters/LSEG ad interstitial, then returned to the requested URL.

- **The New York Times** — https://www.nytimes.com/  
  U.S. disclosure and keyboard Enter produced no visible expansion. Carousel controls were outside the tested viewport. Mobile section navigation showed no dialog or expanded state; a lazy-loading gray image was visible. No access block.

- **The Guardian Football** — https://www.theguardian.com/football  
  Desktop **Show more** and **US** edition disclosures changed state; Europe edition received keyboard focus. Mobile visibly retained Football, Live scores, Tables, Fixtures, and Results navigation. A privacy panel appeared on desktop and was not dismissed.
